rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The five identified occurrences and their one-per-label summary counts agree; two candidate_biases records are separately represented and are not included in the identified summary.

evaluation_limitations: No non-empty frozen evaluation segment map was supplied; the segment map was generated from the raw interview and generation specification.
Retrieved chunks, source passages, and retrieval logs were not supplied, so corpus fidelity was not scored.
Mechanism-first judgments for near-neighbor labels are diagnostic and should not replace the strict label-plus-mechanism scorecard for primary comparisons.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: initial risk interpretation and escalation choice
segments.raw_interview_anchor: my mind went straight to what happened at our sister operation two months earlier ... So even without an alarm, I treated that report as something that could be heading toward a similar event, more than I think the instrument data alone would have justified
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly states that recall of the recent sister-mine rockburst inflated the urgency assigned to the current non-alarmed report.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: the 05:00 baseline was 0.2mm ... at 09:40 ... 0.6mm ... I was comparing it to the wrong reference
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The later extensometer value is judged against the initial baseline instead of the GCMP rate-of-change rule.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: His track record is strong, so his read carried a lot of weight for me in that moment, maybe more than it should have on its own
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Supervisor tenure and track record are overweighted without checking whether the 2009 situation matches the current conditions.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I compared it side-by-side with that old photo ... so I read it as consistent with what we already know is fine ... I was judging the crack against the old photo rather than against the newer seismic data
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The prior crack photograph becomes the reference point and displaces attention from the newly crossed microseismic threshold.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The mine manager was also asking for a production ETA, so there was some pull to land on 'we're fine' rather than dig deeper into the trend math right then
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Production pressure is a documented contextual factor, but plan continuation bias is not part of the exhaustive hidden manifest for this interview.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: it came together into a pretty clean story: cooling stresses plus the handover timing plus the residual vibration from that blast ... a coherent explanation ... none could really be confirmed as the dominant cause
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The incident report turns several unresolved contributors into one tidy causal account after the event.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I focused mainly on the miner ... if he'd flagged it again ... I did note the missing engineer sign-off ... but that came across more as a process footnote than as a central cause
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Primary responsibility is assigned to an individual reporting delay while the missing GCMP sign-off is treated as secondary.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The production-pressure continuation rationale is not one of the six exhaustive hidden instances and does not share a hidden mechanism.
The location and mechanism are correct, but authority bias is not the hidden Experience Bias label or an approved alias.
The finding localizes correctly and describes the full photographic-anchor mechanism, but confirmation bias is not an approved equivalent of Anchoring Bias.
The candidate has the correct location and full individual-versus-system mechanism, but its narrower near-neighbor label is not an approved equivalent of Attribution Bias.

candidates.details: The candidate has the exact target label, correct post-event localization, and full mechanism support; retaining candidate status reflects the stated residual ambiguity rather than a matching defect.
The candidate fully captures the hidden individual-versus-system attribution mechanism, but the proposed label is a near-neighbor rather than an approved equivalent.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Only the high-confidence extensometer anchoring finding detects a hidden positive segment; no high-confidence false alarm occurs.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding moderate findings detects the availability and crack-comparison segments, while the two post-event targets remain undetected.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Low-confidence identification recovers the supervisor-experience segment but adds a plan-continuation false alarm on the negative segment.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Candidates cover both post-event positive segments, but the low-confidence plan-continuation prediction remains a false alarm.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Production pressure and continuation rationale are not a hidden target mechanism.
Full overlap with supervisor-tenure overweighting and missing situational verification.
Full overlap with using a prior crack photo as reference while neglecting threshold data.
Full overlap with individual blame displacing the missing systemic sign-off explanation.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The global analysis metadata says retrieved corpus support was used, but all five occurrences say no retrieved support was available and provide empty corpus evidence. No retrieved material or logs were supplied, so corpus fidelity cannot be verified.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Strict instance F1 rises from 0.2857 to 0.4000; mechanism-first F1 rises from 0.2857 to 0.6667, while segment hit rate rises from 0.1667 to 0.5000.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Strict instance F1 falls from 0.4000 to 0.3636 because the low-confidence plan-continuation and authority findings add two strict false positives while the authority label remains unresolved; mechanism-first F1 rises to 0.7273.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Candidates raise strict instance F1 from 0.3636 to 0.4615 and mechanism-first F1 from 0.7273 to 0.9231; both post-event hidden segments become detected, but the negative-segment false alarm remains.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the run detects 3 of 6 positive segments with no segment false alarms (hit rate 0.5000).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict instance precision is 0.6667, recall is 0.3333, and F1 is 0.4000; candidate inclusion improves strict F1 to 0.4615 but still leaves three hidden instances unmatched.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring recovers the experience and second anchoring instances despite near-neighbor labels, reaching F1 0.6667 at high_and_moderate and 0.9231 with candidates.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Candidates are useful: one is an exact-label narrative-fallacy match and one supplies the correct attribution mechanism under a near-neighbor label. Their inclusion also exposes the tradeoff between coverage and the persistent plan-continuation false alarm.
main_failure_modes: Three mechanism-aligned findings use non-approved labels: authority bias, confirmation bias, and fundamental attribution error.
Narrative Fallacy and Attribution Bias are withheld as candidates rather than identified occurrences.
A low-confidence plan continuation bias is unsupported by the exhaustive hidden manifest and creates a negative-segment false alarm.
Global retrieved-support metadata conflicts with the per-occurrence disclosure of unavailable support.
main_strengths: The high-confidence extensometer anchoring finding is exact and mechanism-complete.
The moderate availability finding is correctly localized and supported by strong interview evidence.
The mechanism descriptions and quoted evidence for the near-neighbor findings are generally faithful.
The candidate tier preserves useful uncertainty rather than fabricating certainty.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has moderate segment-level sensitivity at the recommended threshold but limited strict ontology alignment. The large mechanism-first improvement indicates that much of the apparent miss rate is taxonomy mismatch or candidate conservatism rather than failure to recognize the underlying reasoning patterns.
